datasetMetadata.datasetName: Verified Region III Contextual Agricultural Advisory Knowledge Base
datasetMetadata.scope: Rain-fed farmers in Zimbabwe Natural Region III; irrigation is not required.
datasetMetadata.systemType: Verified agricultural knowledge + farmer profile/GPS + live weather + rule-based decision engine + weighted symptom matching; not AI/ML.
datasetMetadata.sourceCurrencyPolicy: Current varieties, pesticides, fertilizer products/rates and seasonal notices must be checked against current AGRITEX/government guidance.
datasetMetadata.regionalCaution: Region III is a study scope and not a uniform permanent rainfall boundary; use GPS-specific weather.

diseaseMatcher.name: Weighted symptom-matching algorithm
diseaseMatcher.formula: sum(matching symptom weights)/sum(all disease symptom weights)*100
diseaseMatcher.farmerLanguage: Possible disease; match score; matched symptoms; this is not a laboratory diagnosis.
diseaseMatcher.lowConfidenceAction: Refer uncertain, severe or overlapping cases.
